D.t: Emilia Sykes leads by 22.2 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 70,487 votes; a one point swing is about 1,586 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +13.3 and D +31.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.1M cash against $78K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.1 points away from Emilia Sykes. Election Day has to make it up: the remaining vote must break harder your way than the forecast expects.

R.t: Carey Coleman trails by 22.2 and wins 0% of simulations. Closing it takes about 35,244 voters switching sides, or 70,487 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +31.3 and D +13.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$78K cash against $1.1M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
